definitions.Interface Declarations: signature/entry function exposing an API with minimal logic
definitions.State Mutators: general-purpose function that reassigns or mutates state
definitions.Callbacks & Closures: built around closures or callbacks (handlers, async continuations)
definitions.Parameter Forwarders: thin, many-argument glue that forwards to other code
definitions.Compute Cores: dense algorithmic logic (high decision density per line)
definitions.C Struct Operations: operates on C structs and pointers (data-structure logic)
definitions.Many-Argument Workhorses: large, many-parameter procedural function doing heavy lifting
definitions.I/O & Config Routines: dominated by I/O and configuration handling
definitions.Defensive Guards: validation and error handling (null checks, guards, early bailouts)
definitions.Unclassified: no dominant structural signature (too small or ambiguous)

older_set.Stateful Encapsulated Methods: method that holds state behind private scope (label from an older engine set; meaning approximate)
older_set.Annotated & Test Methods: annotated or test method (label from an older engine set; meaning approximate)
